source: the team's hosted test build on Railway (address not published) — GET only: /api/sessions (listing), /api/sessions/{id} (summary + stored events, one file per session in sessions/), /api/trace?session={id}&n=100000 (traces/, only the sessions still in the server's memory), /api/review (review_server.json, the server's own aggregate, which read every trace file on its disk)

testers.test-claude: automated (Claude-driven, synthetic clip): Claude Code drove the hosted site with a synthetic or replayed clip as the camera; not a person

pseudonymisation: real tester names replaced by T1-T3 everywhere (username, trace user, review keys); the mapping is not committed. No free-text notes from people exist in the snapshot (the only feedback 'detail' text is test-claude's 'automated check by Claude (synthetic clip)'). pixels: none: the service never stores frames; these files hold events, summaries and trace rows only (checked by tests/test_team_test_report.py: no inline image, base64 or JPEG payloads)
traces_note: traces/ holds 6 of 15 sessions (all T1): the other sessions' traces were no longer in the server's memory and /api/trace serves memory only. Agent totals over all 15 sessions therefore come from review_server.json.
